name: Y-BOCS
title: Yale-Brown Obsessive Compulsive Scale
description: A 10-item clinical screening scale designed to rate the severity and type of symptoms in patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder.

instructions.text: For each item, select the rating that best describes your experience over the past week.

questions.text: Time occupied by obsessive thoughts: How much of your time is occupied by obsessive thoughts?
Interference due to obsessive thoughts: How much do your obsessive thoughts interfere with work or social activities?
Distress associated with obsessive thoughts: How much distress or anxiety do your obsessive thoughts cause you?
Resistance against obsessions: How much effort do you make to resist the obsessive thoughts?
Degree of control over obsessive thoughts: How much control do you have over your obsessive thoughts?
Time spent performing compulsive behaviors: How much time do you spend performing compulsive rituals?
Interference due to compulsive behaviors: How much do your compulsive behaviors interfere with social or work functioning?
Distress associated with compulsive behavior: How anxious would you feel if prevented from performing rituals?
Resistance against compulsions: How much effort do you make to resist the compulsions?
Degree of control over compulsive behavior: How strong is your drive to perform the compulsive behavior?
